sources.title: Granite 4.1 8B model | NanoGPT
sources.snippet: IBM's Granite 4.1 8B is a dense, decoder-only 8-billion-parameter instruction model built for enterprise text workflows, including tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, code generation with fill-in-the-middle support, summarization, classification, extraction, and multilingual assistance.
